# N&D Co.

> Brand and growth agency in Barrackpore, Kolkata, India: brand identity and logos, websites, e-commerce and software, SEO, digital marketing, social media, video and content for businesses across India and worldwide.

Every page below is also available as Markdown: add .md to its address (https://ndcompany.in/index.md for the homepage). [llms-full.txt](https://ndcompany.in/llms-full.txt) holds the full text of the main pages in one file.

## Services

- [All services](https://ndcompany.in/services): overview of every service, with links to each page.
- [Website Design & Development](https://ndcompany.in/services/website-design-development): Responsive websites, e-commerce development, and SEO-optimized web solutions.
- [SEO Services](https://ndcompany.in/services/seo-services): On-page, off-page, and technical SEO to improve rankings and drive organic traffic.
- [Full Branding Solutions](https://ndcompany.in/services/full-branding-solutions): Complete branding including logo design, identity, and marketing materials.
- [Software Development](https://ndcompany.in/services/software-development): Custom web applications, CRM systems, and internal business software.
- [Mobile App Development](https://ndcompany.in/services/mobile-app-development): Android and iOS apps for restaurants, shops, and businesses, built once and published on both stores.
- [Brand Identity Design](https://ndcompany.in/services/brand-identity-design): Logo design, brand guidelines, and visual identity systems.
- [E-commerce Solutions](https://ndcompany.in/services/ecommerce-solutions): Online store development with payment integration and optimization.
- [Digital Marketing & Performance Marketing](https://ndcompany.in/services/digital-marketing): Google Ads, social media marketing, and ROI-focused campaigns.
- [Social Media Management](https://ndcompany.in/services/social-media-management): Content planning, posting, and audience growth strategies.
- [Video Production & Editing](https://ndcompany.in/services/video-production-editing): Video ads, reels, and promotional content production.
- [Graphic Design](https://ndcompany.in/services/graphic-design): Posters, banners, ad creatives, and marketing graphics.

- [Content Creation](https://ndcompany.in/services/content-creation): SEO content, blogs, and social media content.

## Locations

- [Locations](https://ndcompany.in/locations): the countries we work with remotely from Kolkata, how projects run across timezones and how payment works from each.
- [India](https://ndcompany.in/locations/india): Brand and growth agency in Kolkata serving businesses across India, from West Bengal to the Seven Sisters: websites, e-commerce, SEO, branding and marketing.
- [Bangladesh](https://ndcompany.in/locations/bangladesh): N&D Co. serves businesses in Bangladesh remotely from Kolkata: websites, e-commerce, branding, SEO and marketing, in Bengali and English, in your timezone.
- [United States](https://ndcompany.in/locations/usa): Outsource web development, e-commerce, SEO and design to N&D Co. in Kolkata, India: prices in US dollars, overnight turnaround, and white label for agencies.
- [Netherlands](https://ndcompany.in/locations/netherlands): N&D Co. works remotely with businesses in the Netherlands: websites, webshops, branding, SEO and marketing, with hours overlapping most of the Dutch workday.

## Blogs

- [Blogs](https://ndcompany.in/blogs): Insights, quick tips and plain guides from N&D Co., a brand and growth agency in Kolkata, on branding, websites, SEO and marketing for growing businesses.
- [What do Google Play and the App Store require from a business app in 2026?](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/play-store-app-store-requirements): What Google Play and the App Store require from a business app in 2026: developer accounts, D-U-N-S, 12-tester closed testing, privacy forms and review times.
- [How much does SEO cost in India in 2026?](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/seo-cost-india): What SEO costs in India in 2026: monthly package prices from 108 agency websites, what a fee covers, red flags, GST and how to compare quotes.
- [How do you optimize content for LLMs?](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/optimize-content-for-llms): What Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity say about their crawlers, robots.txt, llms.txt and content, and how to check your own site for AI search.
- [How do schools and colleges do SEO?](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/seo-for-educational-institutions): How schools, colleges and coaching institutes get found on Google: admission and fee pages, a Business Profile per campus, titles, reviews and language pages.
- [How healthy are Kolkata small-business websites? We checked 901 businesses](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/kolkata-small-business-websites): Half of 901 Kolkata businesses on Google Maps have no website. We checked the rest: dead links, missing basics, local markup and mobile speed, 30 October 2026.
- [What Indian agencies charge in 2026: prices from 108 agency websites](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/agency-prices-india): What Indian digital agencies charge in 2026: published website, SEO, store, social and ads prices from 108 agency websites in eight cities, checked 29 October.
- [How to outsource web development to India: a guide for US businesses](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/outsource-web-development-india): Outsource web development or digital marketing to India from the US: what it costs, how the time difference works, what to agree in writing and how to pay.
- [How to run a local SEO audit: a checklist for small businesses](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/local-seo-audit): Run a local SEO audit in an afternoon: your Google Business Profile, matching details on Bing, Apple Maps, location pages, reviews, links and what to measure.
- [How much does a website cost in India in 2026?](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/website-cost-india): What a website costs in India in 2026: the build from ₹9,999, then domain, hosting, Shopify, payment gateway fees, email and GST, at each provider's own prices.
- [What does a small business website cost in 2026?](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/small-business-website-cost): What a small business website costs in 2026: the build from $149, then domain, hosting, Shopify, card fees, email and the ADA, at each provider's own prices.
- [How our free SEO audit works, from request to report](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/free-seo-audit-how-it-works): How our free website SEO audit works: what the form asks, the safety checks, the ten pages we read, how findings are ranked, and a sample SEO audit report.
- [Technical SEO checklist for small business websites](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/technical-seo-checklist): Twelve technical SEO checks for a small business website, in priority order: Search Console, indexing, robots.txt, sitemap, HTTPS, phones, speed and schema.
- [How to plan a business website before you hire anyone](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/plan-a-business-website): Plan a business website before you hire: set its one job, sketch pages for phones, keep the domain in your name and copy our one-page brief for quotes.
- [Logo vs brand identity: what you are paying for](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/logo-vs-brand-identity): A logo is one mark; a brand identity is the system around it. See what each includes, who owns your logo in India and how to register it as a trademark.
- [Core Web Vitals explained for business owners](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/core-web-vitals-explained): What LCP, INP and CLS measure, the marks a page must hit to pass, how websites score on phones in India and what to ask your developer to fix.
- [Google Business Profile: a setup and upkeep guide for local businesses](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/google-business-profile-guide): Set up and verify a Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business) in India, ask for reviews within Google's rules and avoid suspensions.
- [What goes into a brand style guide, and how to use one](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/brand-style-guide): What brand guidelines need: logo versions and platform sizes, colour pairs that pass contrast checks, font licences, Indian scripts, voice rules and templates.
- [SEO](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/topic/seo): SEO tips, guides and insights from N&D Co. for small businesses: technical checks, indexing and Google Business Profile, with links to Google documentation.
- [Websites](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/topic/websites): Website tips and guides from N&D Co. for business owners: planning a site before you hire anyone, page speed and Core Web Vitals, and what to fix first.
- [Branding](https://ndcompany.in/blogs/topic/branding): Branding tips and guides from N&D Co.: what separates a logo from a brand identity, which files you should receive, and what a brand style guide needs.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://ndcompany.in/projects): software, marketing, branding and design work, one page per client with everything we did for them, and the client's review where there is one.
- [Branding projects](https://ndcompany.in/projects/category/branding): Logos and brand identities for new and growing businesses: a seafood wholesaler, a wall texture maker, food brands, a pub, a hair salon and a coffee shop.
- [Design projects](https://ndcompany.in/projects/category/design): Social media posts, ad creatives, thumbnails and other graphics.
- [Case management platform for Bangali Oikya Manch](https://ndcompany.in/projects/bangali-oikya-manch): An applicant portal and case management system for Bangali Oikya Manch, a community service organisation. Reported cases a day: about 5 to 6 by hand and 30 to 40 on a typical day with the platform.
- [Brand identity for Sea Seven Fish](https://ndcompany.in/projects/sea-seven-fish): A brand identity for Sea Seven Fish, a seafood wholesaler from Northeast India: 18 logo concepts, a fish with a fin of mountain peaks, a blue palette, a seal and business cards.
- [Brand identity for Innovation Texture](https://ndcompany.in/projects/innovation-texture): A logo and brand identity for Innovation Texture, a wall texture maker in Vadodara: a rising sun that forms the letters I and T, five palettes, lockups and mockups.
- [Ads, design, reels and social media for Kebabiyana](https://ndcompany.in/projects/kebabiyana): Ads, graphic design, reel editing and social media management for Kebabiyana, a restaurant.
- [Marketing and design for Wafflery's](https://ndcompany.in/projects/wafflerys): Marketing and graphic design for Wafflery's, a growing food venture in Kolkata.
- [Pio Bhai offer creative for Dream Bar](https://ndcompany.in/projects/dream-bar): An offer creative for Dream Bar, a bar and restaurant in Barrackpore, Kolkata, for its Pio Bhai weekend promotion.
- [Gym promotion creative for Iron Nerve Fitness](https://ndcompany.in/projects/iron-nerve-fitness): A promotion creative for Iron Nerve Fitness, a premium Roman-themed gym.
- [Food posts and ad creatives](https://ndcompany.in/projects/food-poster-series): Five food social media posts and ad creatives: a Kolkata brunch, a biryani, a chicken wrap, medu vada and a breakfast promo called Bread and Butter.
- [YouTube thumbnail series](https://ndcompany.in/projects/youtube-thumbnail-series): Seven YouTube thumbnails for videos on fitness, food, travel, gaming, beauty, money and DIY.
- [Logo for Edli Delight](https://ndcompany.in/projects/edli-delight): A modern logo for Edli Delight, a South Indian food chain: the name in green inside a brushed circle, beside a stack of idlis.
- [Logo for Koustav Kitchen](https://ndcompany.in/projects/koustav-kitchen): A logo for Koustav Kitchen, a cloud kitchen startup that sells through Zomato: a cartoon chef with a whisk in a round badge.
- [Logo for North East, a pub and bar](https://ndcompany.in/projects/north-east-pub-and-bar): A logo for North East, a pub and bar in Jaipur, built around two clinking beer mugs.
- [Logo for Style & Co.](https://ndcompany.in/projects/style-and-co): A startup logo for Style & Co., a unisex hair salon in Salt Lake, Kolkata.
- [Logo for Sunfresso](https://ndcompany.in/projects/sunfresso): A logo for Sunfresso, a coffee shop in Kolkata: a steaming cup under an arc, above the name and the words Coffee Shop.
- [Logo for Taste and Bite](https://ndcompany.in/projects/taste-and-bite): A logo for Taste and Bite, a restaurant in Bhopal: a round badge with a flame over a crossed fork and spatula.

## Open source

- [Open source](https://ndcompany.in/open-source): Open-source code by Nakshatra Ranjan Saha, founder of N&D Co., starting with MailGrab, a Python email crawler: what each project does and how to run it.
- [MailGrab](https://ndcompany.in/open-source/mailgrab) (Python, MIT licence): A crawler for checking which email addresses your own websites publish, and on which pages. It checks robots.txt by default and also runs as an MCP server. Source: https://github.com/OCEANOFANYTHING/MailGrab; website: https://oceanofanything.github.io/MailGrab/; current version v2.0.0, released 2026-09-03

## Free tools

- [Free tools](https://ndcompany.in/tools): Free tools from N&D Co. that run in your browser: RankGuru checks a page for on-page SEO, plus an invoice generator and an image to PDF converter.
- [RankGuru](https://ndcompany.in/tools/rankguru): Checks a web page's title, description, headings, links, images and structured data, and compares its words with up to three competitor pages.
- [Invoice generator](https://ndcompany.in/tools/invoice-generator): Makes an invoice, proforma invoice or quote with GST or other taxes, discounts and a UPI QR code, with a live preview, then prints it or saves it as a PDF.
- [Image to PDF](https://ndcompany.in/tools/image-to-pdf): Turns JPEG, PNG, WebP and other images into one PDF, in the order you choose, on A4, Letter or image-sized pages. Your images never leave your device.

## Tags

Subjects shared by the blogs and the projects; each tag page lists both.

- [Logos](https://ndcompany.in/tags/logos): The logo versions, file formats and sizes a business needs, from a square icon that survives a circle crop to vector files for signs and print.
- [Food and drink branding](https://ndcompany.in/tags/food-and-drink-branding): Logos, posters and promotions for restaurants, cafes, cloud kitchens and bars.
- [Working with an agency](https://ndcompany.in/tags/working-with-an-agency): Hiring a designer, developer or agency: what to ask before you pay, what to put in writing and how to keep ownership of your domain, accounts and files.
- [Core Web Vitals](https://ndcompany.in/tags/core-web-vitals): How Google measures loading, response to taps and clicks, and layout shifts on real visits, the scores it calls good and how to check your own pages.
- [Social media creatives](https://ndcompany.in/tags/social-media-creatives): Social media posts, ad creatives and posters for dishes, offers, events and memberships.
- [Local SEO](https://ndcompany.in/tags/local-seo): Showing up when people nearby search for what you sell, and the relevance, distance and prominence that Google weighs when it ranks local results.
- [Technical SEO](https://ndcompany.in/tags/technical-seo): Crawling, indexing, sitemaps, canonical URLs, HTTPS and the other site settings that decide whether Google can find, read and show your pages.
- [Website costs](https://ndcompany.in/tags/website-costs): What a website costs to build and run: design and development, domains, hosting, store platforms, payment fees and tax, with the published prices behind each figure.
- [Brand guidelines](https://ndcompany.in/tags/brand-guidelines): Brand style guides that others can follow without asking you: logo rules, colour codes, fonts, voice and templates, kept as one current version.
- [Google Business Profile](https://ndcompany.in/tags/google-business-profile): Claiming, verifying and keeping your free Google listing accurate on Search and Maps, from categories and hours to suspensions and appeals.
- [Google Search Console](https://ndcompany.in/tags/google-search-console): Setting up Google's free Search Console with the business as owner, then reading its indexing and Core Web Vitals reports and checking that fixes work.
- [SEO audits](https://ndcompany.in/tags/seo-audits): What an SEO audit checks on a website, how its findings are ranked and scored, and how to read the report it produces.
- [Web accessibility](https://ndcompany.in/tags/web-accessibility): WCAG in plain words: contrast ratios for text, alt text, labelled form fields and tap targets, and how to write them into a website brief or a style guide.
- [Website planning](https://ndcompany.in/tags/website-planning): Decisions to settle before anyone designs or builds your site: its one job, its pages, the content you supply, the platform and a written brief.
- [All tags](https://ndcompany.in/tags): every tag on the blogs and projects, with its posts and projects.
